 Keaton Wagler puts up 15 in win over Kings 
 by Garrett Ball | Clippers Correspondent | Thu, Oct 22nd 2026, 10:55am EDT 
 Keaton Wagler scored 15 points (4-8 FG, 3-6 3P, 4-4 FT) with five rebounds, five assists, and two steals in the Clippers’ 121-96 win over the Kings. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 The rookie had a great NBA debut, contributing off the bench, finishing second in scoring off the bench behind Brook Lopez. The 19 year old should become a great fantasy asset, especially as his role and experience grows.
